zh: 题目数的是不同的“数值对”，与下标和重复次数无关；而且 k 固定后，a 一确定 b=a+k 就确定了。
先把数组去重成一个集合，对集合里每个值 a 检查 a+k 是否也在集合中；因为允许同一下标自配，k=0 时每个不同值都算一对。
把所有数放进哈希集合；遍历集合中每个 a，若 a+k 在集合中就计数加一；输出计数。
en: The problem counts distinct value pairs, regardless of indices or repetitions; and with k fixed, choosing a determines b = a + k.
Deduplicate the array into a set and check for each value a in the set whether a+k is also present; since an index may pair with itself, every distinct value forms a pair when k=0.
Put all numbers in a hash set; for each a in the set add one to the count when a+k is in the set; print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After removing duplicates, check for each a whether a+k exists.

## Correctness

Once k is fixed, a uniquely determines b, so each a in the set that satisfies the condition corresponds to exactly one distinct value pair. Pairing a value with itself does not require two indices, so the same reasoning applies directly when k=0.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), space O(n).
